# debian/common/packages.txt - installed on every card, whatever the
# desktop. Only what is needed and proven on the tablet. One package per
# line; "#" starts a comment. Installed without Recommends.
#
# Base system (the tablet's first card, 2026-09-25)
systemd-sysv
udev
dbus
dbus-user-session
libpam-systemd
systemd-resolved
systemd-timesyncd
kmod
sudo
locales
tzdata
console-setup
console-data
kbd
apt-utils
debian-archive-keyring
ca-certificates
# ping as a normal user: since trixie ping has no raw-socket capability
# and relies on net.ipv4.ping_group_range, set by this package
linux-sysctl-defaults
# polkit: iio-sensor-proxy (screen rotation) and hostnamed ask it
polkitd
# Network: Wi-Fi, SSH, names on the local network (<host>.local)
wpasupplicant
iw
wireless-regdb
iproute2
iputils-ping
openssh-server
avahi-daemon
libnss-mdns
curl
wget
# Bluetooth, sound, volume keys
bluez
alsa-utils
triggerhappy
# Cameras: cam-snap (v4l-utils; raw2png.py needs numpy)
v4l-utils
python3
python3-numpy
# Hardware checks
i2c-tools
usbutils
evtest
fbset
# Files and disks
e2fsprogs
dosfstools
fdisk
parted
rsync
file
unzip
util-linux-extra
# Shell
bash-completion
less
nano
vim-tiny
micro
mc
htop
procps
psmisc
man-db
manpages
# console font (Terminus)
fonts-terminus
